provenance: Integer vectors hand-calculated from g(x)=clamp(2*x,-1000,1000) in i64 and the frozen H2 recurrence; values are independent of the Mimi implementations.

allocation_claim.required: static no_alloc proof and native physical allocation count of zero in the declared hot region

H3.expected_value_semantics: The retained snapshot remains unchanged while the unique working owner is updated; active prefix only, tail preserved.

allocation_claim.required: shared call rejected under no_alloc as possible COW; exclusive call has zero static/physical allocations

push_pop_growth.expected: Reject push/pop/resize/replacement and any possible backing-store growth in the hot call graph.

transform_collection.expected: Reject concat/reverse/map/filter or scratch-list transformation in the hot call graph.

live_snapshot_cow.expected: Reject a potentially detaching mutation while an observable snapshot remains live.

unknown_callback_or_ffi.expected: Reject an unknown-effect callback, allocating destructor/defer, or unannotated FFI call reachable from the hot region.

error_and_bounds_paths.expected: Bounds and early-error paths are included in the cost region; reject or prove every path without hiding allocation.
